description: List the starting templates for a campaign step in one language (`en` when left out), six of them: first emails, follow-ups and a last email, each written for its language rather than translated. `id` is the same in every language; `role` is `first`, `follow_up` or `last`. Each has a `subject` (empty on a follow-up or last email, which reply in the conversation), a plain-text `body` with merge fields, its `blanks` (words in double brackets, [[like this]], that you replace with your own) and `advice`, the content check on the template as a sample contact reads it (the same shape as preview_campaign_step's; advice about the words, not a promise about any inbox). To use one, copy `subject` and `body` into add_campaign_step or update_campaign_step (`body` as `bodyText`, with `bodyHtml: ""` on a step that has a formatted part): the step keeps its own copy, and nothing points back at the template. A save that still holds a blank answers 400 `stepBlank`. Nothing is written.

language.description: The language the templates are written in. Left out: en.
